events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of one of rock's most iconic voices. Raise a glass to the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released on October 1, 1971, in the UK, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine's lasting message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song whose message still resonates globally.

events.title: The first iPod was released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed the game. Remember your first one? How many songs did you cram on it?

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend's birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved their incredible versatility.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic Queen frontman, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to a true legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic evolution for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push new boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.
